narration.text: The site's stormwater inspections and corrective actions kept on the permit's schedule. This is a chore for the compliance coordinator of a site contractor grading a retail pad under EPA's Construction General Permit. Read the site's stormwater plan: the inspection schedule, the working hours, the controls, and the maintenance, corrective action and record rules. Athena works it across 4 portals: Docshelf, Rainlog, Permitflow and Sitegrid photos. On the bench, she found 6 of 6 eligible items, worth 1,500 dollars of the 1,500 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 9 traps, and she walked past 9. Among them: A weekend storm already inspected on the Monday. Two drizzles that add up to 0.27 inches, 35 hours apart. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 2 hours, so she was about 52 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
